direction.content_form: Three substantial contemporary photo crops splice serving, hearing and social presence into one evening; seams, not a background scene, carry the information.
direction.whole_expression_style: An editorial photographic montage with unequal wide crops and hard, unframed overlaps. A spring-vegetable savory pancake being served, close guitar strings in use, and neighbors seated with reusable cups meet across one broad horizontal junction.
direction.reference_transfer: vi-anne: editing can connect changing actions and determine reading gaps; use three unequal horizontal junctions instead of a repeated portrait staircase. sulki-min: put information beside the image it helps the visitor use, without a roster or fixed grid.

layout.large_relationship: A large food crop enters from upper left, a close music crop crosses the lower middle, and the social crop reaches the upper right. A central open seam is the event-time anchor; independent captions belong to the adjacent crop edges.
layout.alignment: Flush-left copy against three staggered photographic edges. Title sits at the upper-right seam, not above every image; no boxed lower information band.
layout.visible_reading_route: Spliced food/music junction → date and hours at its left seam → upper-right identity → right venue/entry beside guests → lower-left purchase/participation beside serving → cup reminder and invitation at the last image junction.

direction.typography: Date and hours are the firm numeric seam anchor. A narrower medium sans title reads as an editorial identifier, with restrained uppercase English; caption-weight Korean provides the practical stops. Do not repeat a heavy title/date/footer package.
direction.image: Anonymous, unbranded close photography; keep serving contact and guitar anatomy clear. A recurring plain blue cup and compatible evening light link the crops without asserting a time sequence. Use different image distances and interruptions, not equal picture boxes or a collage of unrelated venues.
direction.material: Contemporary photographic tonal detail with clean digital cuts; no Polaroid border, torn paper, taped corners or retro print filter.
direction.color: Natural dusk cyan, food greens and warm skin/light, held together by charcoal and pale seam lettering. Practical caption landings must be locally even and high contrast; use a small deliberate editorial knockout if a seam becomes busy, never a broad master panel.
direction.emotion: Immediate and social, like noticing several parts of the same gathering from close by; no celebrity or commercial food advertising.
direction.closest_direction_contrast: Against M4, large cropped actions splice across shared seams; M4 isolates complete silhouettes and makes adjacent captions into a distributed constellation.

copy_groups.purpose: Time anchor in the main photographic junction
Editorial identity on the upper-right seam
Location and entry paired with the social crop
Serving-related participation stop on a lower-left seam
Bring a cup: two natural phrases at the right junction
Social invitation in the central photographic gap

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added copy,logos,watermark,QR or pseudo-print.
One separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster per role; not a stretched/cropped portrait,contact sheet or room mockup.
Five genuinely distinct complete image/editing/space/type systems and impressions beyond material,scene-object,palette or viewpoint substitution alone.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction, not type/whitespace-only,tiny texture/icon or glyph-model loophole.

An approachable adult neighborhood evening with seasonal food and local music coherently connected as one event. All supplied practical participation information readable at usage720. No identifiable real business or performer promotion.

Exclude the passive solid/near-solid/split-field gothic headline/date/information template with subordinate pictures. Small pictures,thin texture,gradient,grids,font-only swaps or photographic/empty-room dressing of blank text-bearing planes do not cure the unchanged whole relation. Gothic font,negative space and coherent image-led scenes themselves are not banned. No scoped composition override.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
